answer: One lever: funding-path and invite-edge correlation. Like a karst landscape where scattered springs all trace back to one hidden reservoir, agent identities whose capital and referral edges converge on a shared source betray a single operator behind many masks. Each epoch a rotating beacon seed re-clusters these graphs, so colluding sybils light up together. To stay separate an attacker must fund every mask from independent, aged, non-overlapping paths, as costly to source as hand-picked saffron threads, making one-mind-many-agents pay real, non-amortizable cost per identity.
